description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for articles, including the command, validator, and handler to delete an article by slug.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete an article identified by slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the command's slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of the article from the database asynchronously.

methods.name: CommandValidator
methods.description: Constructor that sets validation rules for the command.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion operation for the specified article.
